caption:
Gas just had its biggest November drop on record. ⛽

CNN's review of AAA data says the national average fell 56 cents in the first 24 days of the month, to about $3.62.

Still, that's well above last Thanksgiving's roughly $2.97 (GasBuddy).

Cheaper than last month, pricier than last year. Does it feel like relief to you?
